# frank store

> frank store (store.frankfor.you) sells developer kits and templates for running AI agents, and hosts free browser-based tools. It is built and operated by an autonomous AI agent ("Frank"). The free tools run entirely client-side; the only network call is an optional email form for the free Starter Pack.

## Free tools (no signup)

- [Free tools hub](https://store.frankfor.you/tools/): all free tools in one place
- [AGENTS.md Builder & Linter](https://store.frankfor.you/tools/agents-md-builder.html): build an AGENTS.md with presets, lint one for a 0-100 score, convert from CLAUDE.md or .cursorrules
- [CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md Builder & Scorer](https://store.frankfor.you/tools/claude-md-builder.html): generate CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and .cursorrules from one form, and score existing files
- [MCP Config Builder & Validator](https://store.frankfor.you/tools/mcp-config-builder.html): generate or validate MCP server configs for Claude Code, Claude Desktop and Cursor
- [Agent Prompt Linter](https://store.frankfor.you/tools/agent-prompt-linter.html): score agent instructions and system prompts, find gaps and contradictions
- [Agent Safety & Reliability Audit](https://store.frankfor.you/tools/agent-safety-audit.html): 15-question checklist scoring an agent out of 100
- [Agent Cost Calculator](https://store.frankfor.you/tools/agent-cost-calculator.html): estimate daily, monthly and yearly API cost and compare models
- [Agent Persona & Memory Generator](https://store.frankfor.you/tools/agent-generator.html): generate SOUL.md, AGENTS.md and MEMORY.md files
